provenance.note: Prototype dataset authored for M1 engineering tests. Sensory attributes are editorial estimates of a typical preparation, not measurements. Ingredient claims describe a generic dish, not any specific recipe or restaurant item. 'confirmed_present' is used only for ingredients that define the dish name; all others are 'possible'; unlisted ingredients are unknown. No absence or allergen-safety claims are made.
provenance.styleNote: Style labels (comfort, light_fresh, hearty, street_food, rich_indulgent, sharing) are editorial judgments of how a dish is typically eaten, not facts; review with the catalog.
provenance.media: No licensed photographs. Cards use clearly labelled illustration placeholders.
